blocks.text: PRAGUE (AP) — A long line of visitors forms daily at a sculpture on Prague’s Charles Bridge, adding a new attraction to the historic 14th-century landmark. Tourists have long flocked to the bridge over the Vltava River to visit the statue of St John of Nepomuk. Now, visitors are lining up at the nearby Pietà sculpture to recreate an iconic 1988 photograph of music icons Depeche Mode. The British electro-rock band first crossed the Iron Curtain in March 1988 to play a historic concert in Prague, then the capital of communist Czechoslovakia.
